The chief executive of OpenAI discusses how artificial intelligence is changing society in this Joe Rogan Experience segment. Sam Altman leads the company whose chatbot opened the AI era to the public. Rogan hosts the man steering the machine age in a careful, measured talk.

Altman lays out the benefits he expects, from science to education, alongside the risks he admits. He explains why he believes building the tech openly beats leaving it to secret labs. Rogan asks about jobs, truth, and who watches the builders. Curious and cautious listeners get power and its price weighed by the man holding much of both.
